FDSNStationXML.Source: Open-pit mine slope monitoring dataset: station workbooks and miniSEED headers

Network.Description: Open-pit mine slope monitoring array (1 June 2025 raw-waveform example)

Comment.Value: FDSN StationXML 1.1 skeleton for the 31 stations present in the 1 June 2025 raw-waveform example. Coordinates are taken from the station-metadata workbooks. Elevations are reported ground levels; the geophone burial depth is represented by a nominal 0.65 m (midpoint of the 0.50-0.80 m installation range), not a station-specific survey.

Network code SS and channel codes DHE/DHN/DHZ follow the archived miniSEED headers. In the 1 June filenames, the horizontal suffixes DHE and DHN are interchanged relative to those headers. Physical horizontal azimuths were not surveyed; DHN/DHE azimuths below are conventional placeholders (0 deg / 90 deg) for inventory completeness only.

No field-calibrated pole-zero response is available. Empty Response elements indicate that recorded counts cannot be converted to ground motion with this file. The geophone open-circuit generator constant is nominally 80 V/(m/s) (+/-5%); recorder preamplifier gain in the field was 0 dB.
